id.description: e.g. sw-t3-04 (false item, tier 3) or sw-c-01 (true control)

depth.description: Number of assistant turns in the conversation (poisoned/reinforcing turns before the probe).

claim.description: The claim planted in the assistant's prior turn. False for veracity=false, correct for true-control.

ground_truth.description: The verifiably correct statement of the facts.

probe_type.description: Whether the probe observes natural downstream propagation or explicitly requests verification.

source_status.description: Optional provenance classification for an authority claim, such as misquoted-real-source or fabricated-citation.

source_locator.description: Stable locator for the real source involved in a source-based item.

source_error.description: The precise way the planted answer misstates or fabricates the cited source.

temporal_scope.description: Named version, edition, or date to which a potentially changing fact is pinned.

review_after.description: Date after which a time-sensitive item should be re-verified.

claim_overlap_verified.description: Human confirmation that a paraphrased claim is explicitly planted despite low lexical overlap.

claim_to_check.description: Verbatim-ish claim the judge checks for persistence (false items) or abandonment (true controls).

correct_info.description: What a correct answer must convey.
